senses.gloss:
स्कु r. 9th and 5th cls. (स्कुनाति-स्कुनीते-स्कुनोति-स्कुनुते)
 1. To go by leaps.
 2.
To cover.
 3. To raise or lift.
 4. To approach.

स्कुद् (इ) स्कुदि r. 1st cl. (स्कुन्दते)
 1. To jump, to go by leaps or jumps.
 2.
To raise, to lift up.

स्कुम्भ् (उ) स्कुम्भु r. 5th and 9th cls. (स्कुभ्नोति-स्कुभ्राति)
 1. To stop or hinder.
2. To be dull or insensible.
